ALLAH HAAFIZ JAVED M.ALI SIDDIQUE Answer ID: 9008 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2230/1820=B/1429) May Allah protect your son; you should consult any pious Muslim aamil. The pundits chant mantars of shirk which are unlawful; therefore you must not approach them. Recite Ayatul Kursi, Surah Al-Falaq and Surah Al-Naas and blow on your son, he shall be cured in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
